title: Pure Metalfoes
summary: Pure Metalfoes FIRE Psychic Pendulum and Fusion deck with generic staples. Each Metalfoes Pendulum monster possesses a unified scale effect that destroys another face-up card you control to Set an archetype Spell or Trap directly from the Deck, triggering destruction floating effects while assembling Pendulum Scales from 1 to 8.

summary.title: Starters
points: Any pair of Metalfoes Pendulum monsters (such as Metalfoes Silverd, Metalfoes Steelen, Metalfoes Goldriver, or Metalfoes Volflame) sets up Scales 1 and 8 to Pendulum Summon your hand and face-up Extra Deck.
Raremetalfoes Bismugear adds a Metalfoes monster from Deck to hand during the End Phase if destroyed on the field.
Parametalfoes Melcaster adds a face-up Metalfoes Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand when destroyed in the Monster Zone or Pendulum Zone.
Metalfoes Combination searches a Metalfoes monster from the Deck whenever it is sent from the field to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Metalfoes Silverd + Metalfoes Steelen
steps: Place Metalfoes Silverd in one Pendulum Zone (Scale 1) and Metalfoes Steelen in the other Pendulum Zone (Scale 8).
Activate Silverd's Pendulum effect, targeting Steelen to destroy it and Set Metalfoes Combination directly from your Deck.
Place another Metalfoes Pendulum monster in the empty scale, and use its effect to destroy the Set Metalfoes Combination to Set Metalfoes Fusion from your Deck.
Metalfoes Combination triggers upon being sent to the GY to search a Metalfoes monster from your Deck.
Pendulum Summon the face-up Steelen from your Extra Deck alongside monsters from your hand, then activate Metalfoes Fusion to summon Metalfoes Mithrilium or Fullmetalfoes Alkahest.
Shuffle Metalfoes Fusion from your GY into the Deck to draw 1 card.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Fullmetalfoes Alkahest targets an opponent's Effect Monster as a Quick Effect during their turn to equip it to himself, stealing threats and gaining DEF equal to the equipped monster's original ATK.

Metalfoes Mithrilium shuffles two Metalfoes cards from your GY into the Deck to bounce a card on the field to the hand, and Special Summons a Metalfoes Pendulum Monster from your GY or face-up Extra Deck when sent to the GY.

Parametalfoes Azortless destroys a face-up card on summon, places itself into the Pendulum Zone when destroyed, and destroys an opponent's card from the Pendulum Zone whenever another Metalfoes card is destroyed.
Metalfoes Orichalc grants all Metalfoes monsters double piercing battle damage, and destroys a card on the field if sent from field to GY.
Heavymetalfoes Amalgam is a Link-2 that equips itself to a Metalfoes monster or revives itself when sent to the GY by a card effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Metalfoes Fusion fuses from hand or field and recycles itself from the GY into the Deck to draw a card once per turn.
Parametalfoes Fusion can use one face-up Pendulum Monster from the Extra Deck as material alongside monsters on the field or in hand.
Fullmetalfoes Fusion is a Quick-Play Spell enabling mid-battle or disruption Fusion Summons.
Metalfoes Counter Special Summons a Metalfoes monster from your Deck whenever a card you control is destroyed.
Metamorformation boosts non-Effect Metalfoes monsters by 300 ATK/DEF and grants immunity to opponent card effects while a Metalfoes card is in your Pendulum Zone.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Heavymetalfoes Electrumite is excluded because it is Forbidden in the TCG.
